definitions.contest_entry: Before first loss, Red has held exclusive foot geometry; body separation <0.65m and both within 0.60m of ball.
definitions.loss: Blue has most recent active foot contact and exclusively occupies forward foot window for >=0.24s.
definitions.breakthrough: Red has most recent active foot contact and exclusive foot window >=0.24s; Red x > Blue x+0.25m and ball x > Blue x+0.35m.
definitions.frontal_contact: Before first loss or breakthrough, actual body contact; both face each other within 60 degrees, both within 0.40m of ball, Red not yet beyond Blue.
definitions.warning: Conditional cohorts change with policy; compare full fixed-layout counts too. Body contact need not be frontal, and later goals do not imply first-contest success.
